sentences.text: 02. 25.02.2026 BVLNC,J I.A.No.01 of 2021 None appeared for the petitioner/appellant/convict.

Heard Sri K.Sandeep, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing the State.
Perused the record.

Petitioner is accused in POCSO S.C.No.183 of 2016 on the file of the learned Special Court for Speedy Trial of the Offences under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act,
2012, East Godavari at Kakinada.

entities.text:
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act,
2012, East Godavari at
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the appellant was convicted for the offence under Section 376 r/w 511 of IPC and Section 9(m) r/w Section 10 of POCSO Act, 2012.

Accordingly,
he was convicted and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten (10) years and to pay a fine of Rs.2,000/- (Rupees Two Thousand only) in default, shall undergo (Contd..) simple imprisonment for a period of six (06) months for the offence under Section 376 r/w 511 of IPC.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the appellant is in prison from the date of judgment i.e., 12.11.2020.
Therefore, he served nearly 5  years of sentence out of ten years sentence.

Considering the above submissions, facts of the case and as the petitioner served 5  years sentence out of ten years of sentence of imprisonment and as there is no possibility of hearing the appeal in the near future, "the order of sentence of imprisonment alone imposed by the learned Special Court for Speedy Trial of the Offences under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO)
Act, 2012, East Godavari at Kakinada vide judgment dated 12.11.2020 in POCSO S.C.No.183 of 2016 shall be suspended, pending disposal of the appeal, subject to the following conditions":
i) The petitioner/appellant/accused shall be enlarged on bail, on executing a personal bond for Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only), with two (02) sureties for a like sum each, to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
ii) On such release, the petitioner/ appellant/accused shall appear before the learned trial Court, on every fourth Saturday of the month, till disposal of the Appeal.
iii) The petitioner/appellant/accused shall pay the fine amount before the learned trial Court within four (04) weeks from the date of this order, if not paid, and file receipt before this Court.
CRLA/314/2021 on 25 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82414238/
1 iv)
The petitioner/appellant/accused shall not intimidate or annoy or contact the victim in any manner.
v) The petitioner/appellant/accused shall not leave the country without permission of the Court.
vi) If the petitioner/appellant/accused violates any of the above conditions, the prosecution is at liberty to file an application seeking cancellation of the bail.
List the matter in the last week of April, 2026 under the caption "Final Hearing".

Registry is directed to address a letter to the Secretary, A.P. High Court Legal Services Committee for appointment of another Legal Aid Counsel to defend the brief of the appellant during Final Hearing.
